import framebuf
w, h = 240, 320
# GS2_HMSB packs 4px/byte, each row padded UP to a whole byte -- ceil(w/4)
# is the real per-row byte count display_spi's own codegen expects, same
# "pad to a byte boundary" rule gs4 established (display-spi.ts's header).
stride = (w + 3) // 4
buf = bytearray(stride * h)
fb = framebuf.FrameBuffer(buf, w, h, framebuf.GS2_HMSB)
# Default palette indices (display_spi's own DEFAULT_PALETTE_GS4, only
# the first 4 entries are read in gs2 mode): 0 black, 1 white, 2 red,
# 3 green -- palette property left unset on purpose, same as the gs4 test
# flow, to also exercise the no-palette-property default path.
fb.fill(0)
fb.text('GS2 240x320', 8, 8, 1)
fb.fill_rect(0, 40, w, 90, 2)
fb.fill_rect(0, 130, w, 90, 3)
fb.ellipse(120, 260, 50, 50, 1, True)
msg['payload'] = bytes(buf)
return msg
